views.markdown: Professional website downloader - Rip websites completely

WebRip (1.0.0-1) stable; urgency=medium
  * Initial release - Full official version
  [New Features]
  ✓ Full support for Dopamine-roothide and Dopamine-Rootless
  ✓ Dual architecture support (arm64 & arm64e)
  ✓ Modern UI with beautiful gradient effects
  ✓ Professional About screen with developer info and social links
  ✓ Complete wget integration for website downloading
  ✓ Advanced progress tracking with speed and time estimation
  ✓ Interactive terminal log with color-coded messages
  ✓ Recent URLs history with delete and add functionality
  ✓ Export download reports as text files
  ✓ Open folders directly in Filza file manager
  ✓ Safari integration for opening links
  ✓ Cryptocurrency donation options (Bitcoin)
  ✓ Animated progress bar with percentage display
  ✓ Cancel download functionality at any time
  ✓ Copy file paths to clipboard
  [Technical Improvements]
  ⚡ Significantly improved processing speed for large downloads
  ⚡ Optimized memory management to prevent crashes
  ⚡ Custom Menlo fonts for terminal display
  ⚡ Smooth transitions between screens
  ⚡ Full iPad support for all screen sizes
  ⚡ Improved touch response across all UI elements
  ⚡ Dark mode and dynamic appearance support
  [Bug Fixes]
  🔧 Fixed wget path detection in different jailbreak types
  🔧 Fixed permission issues in download folder
  🔧 Fixed app icon display on home screen
  🔧 Fixed downloading issues with encrypted URLs
  🔧 Fixed app freeze when canceling downloads
  🔧 Overall stability improvements
  [Requirements]
  📱 iOS 15.0 or later
  🔓 Dopamine-roothide or Dopamine-Rootless
  📦 wget package (apt install wget)
  💾 At least 50MB free storage
  [Installation Instructions]
  📥 For Dopamine-roothide
